a: walkControls takes Left/Right away from a text input, select or range in a row's control cell
useScrollSpy drops a clicked section in a container that does not scroll, or one that cannot reach the top
The roving and row-focus hooks read the global `document`'s focus, not their container's document
useRovingTabIndex keeps the tab stop on an item hidden by a class or style change
b: walkControls takes over Left and Right inside a text input (or any control that uses arrows) in a row's control cell
useRovingTabIndex keeps the tab stop on an item that a class or style change has hidden
createDomFocusScope never lets Tab land on an `<area href>`, though its selector lists it
moveFocus from a focused element outside the tab order jumps to a positive-tabindex item instead of the next one in the document
useRemovedRowFocus reads focus from the element's own document in one place and the global `document` in another
